core_MF2.idea: one push to the edge, two switches: the crate must be pushed out of a column by a block that can only leave once switch A reverses it - and the push itself closes switch B's own lane; fire A early, or B late, and a block is boxed in for good
core_MF2.redesign: round 1 core (two crates in open rows) had 5325 positions and a 96.5 ms TIME UP check; the crate now moves at most once (pushed to the edge)

core_PX.idea: the crate travels: pushed into the portal it lands on the far side, in a lane someone still needs - who must leave before the push, and the pusher can only leave after its switch

core_SG3.family: C switch / gate (two switches, flips into deadlocks)
core_SG3.idea: two switches, each turning its own pair: a reversal frees one block and can lock another - the gate opens only when its link is gone

core_MG2.family: D magnet displacement (at most 3 magnets) + lock
core_MG2.idea: a pull moves the key: the magnet drags a block across the lane of a locked block - the order of pulls decides which lanes are open when the lock releases

core_AS.idea: one rammer, two shells, one reversal: the rammer cracks the shell in front, must not leave yet, and is turned around to crack the one behind - leave early or turn early and a shell stays

core_SQX.idea: advance or be pulled: a Sequence block turns when tapped with a clear lane, a magnet drags it elsewhere - in which order decides where its second arrow points

core_PX2.idea: the crate travels and a lane bends back: pushed into the portal the crate lands where another block's lane comes out of the portal - two switches decide who can still leave
core_PX2.redesign: round 1 (PX) reached 3 distinct mistakes: one switch, one trap; a second switch and a flip target whose lane runs through the portal

core_SG4.idea: a reversal can lock two blocks face to face: each switch frees the block it must, but turns another toward a block that waits for it - fire it before that block has left and both are stuck; the gate decides who can leave first
core_SG4.redesign: round 1 (SG3) reached 2 distinct mistakes: its reversals only freed blocks; now each switch also turns a block toward a block that waits for it (an early switch is a deadlock)

core_AS2.family: E rammer / armor (two rammers, two switches)
core_AS2.idea: two rammers, four shells, two reversals: each rammer cracks the shell in front, must stay, and is turned around to crack the one behind - and one switch can only fire once the other pair is done
core_AS2.redesign: round 1 (AS: one rammer, one switch) reached 1 distinct mistake with a 70% shortcut; two rammer / switch pairs, the second switch's lane opened only by the first pair

core_MG3.family: D magnet displacement (two magnets, face-to-face pulls)
core_MG3.idea: a pull can lock two blocks face to face: each magnet drags a block into a lane where it meets a block pointing back at it - each magnet must wait until that block has left, and must still go before the block it is holding up
core_MG3.redesign: round 1 (MG2: one magnet + lock) reached 2 distinct mistakes; two magnets, each pulling a block into a face-to-face deadlock if fired early

core_SQX2.idea: advance or be pulled: Sequence blocks turn when tapped with a clear lane, magnets drag them elsewhere - the order decides where their second arrows point
core_SQX2.redesign: round 1 (SQX) reached 2 distinct mistakes; a second magnet and Sequence block

core_MX4.family: C/D magnet + switch (pull and flip deadlocks)
core_MX4.idea: two ways to lock blocks face to face: the magnet drags a block under one pointing back at it, the switch turns a block toward one waiting for it - each must wait for the right block to leave, and both are needed

core_MAS.idea: push, turn, ram: a block pushes the crate out of a column, is turned around by the switch and must then crack the shell behind it - turn it early and the crate stays, leave a shell and it is stuck

core_MAS2.idea: push, turn, ram - and a second switch the push can shut out: the pusher clears a column, is turned around to crack the shell behind it; the other switch must fire before the crate lands in its lane
core_MAS2.redesign: round 1 (MAS) reached 3 distinct mistakes; a second switch whose lane the pushed crate closes (the MF2 trap)
